usage_step_1_text: In the Manage tab, download the ANR FG package. If the game does not have OptiScaler yet, click 'Install ANR FG Full'. If you already installed OptiScaler separately, click 'Add ANR FG to existing OptiScaler'.
usage_step_2: 2. Enable in game and open menu
usage_step_2_text: In the game settings, turn on DLSS Frame Generation. Press Insert (or the shortcut key configured in Menu & OptiScaler) to open the OptiScaler menu at any time.
usage_step_3_text: To record and compare generated frames, download nr-record in the Manage tab, install it in the Record & Compare tab, and press F6 (start/stop recording) or F9 (capture 8 frames). Then click 'Open Comparator & Viewer'.
